LanguageData.DMSAF_Description:
Current: {0}
Click to switch between vanilla direct fire and original DMS zigzag spray, including during a burst.

Direct fire aims at the selected target using vanilla accuracy, scatter and cover calculations. Spray keeps the original three-sweep zigzag. Burst size, shot intervals, charges, fuel, sounds and muzzle flash are preserved.

Only player-faction units and turrets can switch. Enemies always spray, even with a formerly player-owned gun. The choice follows this gun and is saved. Multi-selection groups matching modes; clicking unifies that group to the other mode.
